props.name: include_deprecated
props.description:
If true, include models whose planned_deprecation_date is in the
past — but only within a three-month grace window after that date. Models whose
planned_deprecation_date is more than three months in the past remain hidden
regardless of this flag. Future planned-deprecation dates are always included
regardless of this flag. Defaults to false, preserving the existing behavior of
hiding all past-dated deprecations.

methods.name: run
methods.summary: This endpoint provides users with the capability to run specific AI models on-demand.
methods.description:
This endpoint provides users with the capability to run specific AI models
on-demand.

By submitting the required input data, users can receive real-time predictions
or results generated by the chosen AI model. The endpoint supports various AI
model types, ensuring flexibility and adaptability for diverse use cases.

Model specific inputs available in
[Cloudflare Docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/).

type.text: TextClassification | TextToImage | TextToSpeech | TextEmbeddings | AutomaticSpeechRecognition | ImageClassification | ObjectDetection | Prompt | Messages | Translation | Summarization | ImageToText | Variant12 | Variant13 | MultimodalEmbeddings

props.name: text
props.description: The text that you want to classify

props.name: prompt
props.description: A text description of the image you want to generate

props.name: guidance
props.description:
Controls how closely the generated image should adhere to the
prompt; higher values make the image more aligned with the prompt

props.name: height
props.description: The height of the generated image in pixels

props.name: image
props.description:
For use with img2img tasks. An array of integers that represent the
image data constrained to 8-bit unsigned integer values

props.name: image_b64
props.description:
For use with img2img tasks. A base64-encoded string of the input
image

props.name: mask
props.description:
An array representing An array of integers that represent mask image
data for inpainting constrained to 8-bit unsigned integer values

props.name: negative_prompt
props.description: Text describing elements to avoid in the generated image

props.name: num_steps
props.description:
The number of diffusion steps; higher values can improve quality but
take longer

props.name: seed
props.description: Random seed for reproducibility of the image generation

props.name: strength
props.description:
A value between 0 and 1 indicating how strongly to apply the
transformation during img2img tasks; lower values make the output closer to the
input image

props.name: width
props.description: The width of the generated image in pixels

props.name: lang
props.description:
The speech language (e.g., 'en' for English, 'fr' for French).
Defaults to 'en' if not specified

props.name: audio
props.description:
An array of integers that represent the audio data constrained to
8-bit unsigned integer values

props.name: source_lang
props.description: The language of the recorded audio

props.name: target_lang
props.description:
The language to translate the transcription into. Currently only
English is supported.

props.name: frequency_penalty
props.description:
Decreases the likelihood of the model repeating the same lines
verbatim.

props.name: lora
props.description:
Name of the LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) model to fine-tune the base
model.

props.name: max_tokens
props.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the response.

props.name: presence_penalty
props.description: Increases the likelihood of the model introducing new topics.

props.name: raw
props.description:
If true, a chat template is not applied and you must adhere to the
specific model's expected formatting.

props.name: repetition_penalty
props.description: Penalty for repeated tokens; higher values discourage repetition.

props.name: stream
props.description:
If true, the response will be streamed back incrementally using SSE,
Server Sent Events.

props.name: temperature
props.description:
Controls the randomness of the output; higher values produce more
random results.

props.name: top_k
props.description:
Limits the AI to choose from the top 'k' most probable words. Lower
values make responses more focused; higher values introduce more variety and
potential surprises.

props.name: top_p
props.description:
Adjusts the creativity of the AI's responses by controlling how many
possible words it considers. Lower values make outputs more predictable; higher
values allow for more varied and creative responses.

content

Whether to ignore the EOS token and continue generating tokens after
